business_problem: Sicredi's support representatives had to answer questions across many financial products, and the previous assistant often required escalation to product specialists, which lengthened wait times for members and made support work more frustrating for employees.
solution_summary: Sicredi partnered with IBM Client Engineering to co-create a generative-AI assistant for its support representatives, focusing first on questions about the cooperative's consortium product. The pilot combined IBM watsonx.ai, IBM Watson Discovery, and IBM watsonx Assistant so staff could submit natural-language questions of varying complexity and receive grounded answers within seconds. In the implemented flow, watsonx Assistant provides the conversational entry point, Discovery searches Sicredi's support documentation, and watsonx.ai helps generate a response that representatives can use while serving members. Sicredi built the first version in three weeks and then tested it over a 20-day pilot with live customer-support traffic. Rather than replacing representatives, the architecture augments them with faster access to product knowledge, reduces unnecessary escalation to specialists, and creates a reusable support pattern the team plans to expand to all financial products.
